Proposed program framework

Turn interests into practical capabilities.

PIT’s initial academic framework is designed around applied learning, portfolio development, communication, and career readiness. Final program names and accreditation details will be confirmed before launch.

Proposed School 01

Business & Entrepreneurship

Business operations, digital marketing, project management, entrepreneurship, and professional communication.

View proposed curriculum →
Proposed School 02

Information Technology & AI

Web and application foundations, data, AI tools, cloud systems, cybersecurity basics, and team projects.

View proposed curriculum →
Proposed School 03

Design & Digital Media

Graphic design, UI/UX, branding, visual communication, digital content, and portfolio preparation.

View proposed curriculum →
Proposed School 04

Music & Creative Arts

Performance, music production, digital audio, ensemble practice, creative collaboration, and portfolio work.

View proposed curriculum →
